### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Name a model's provider as its credential destination](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3464) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — On the organization credential form, a model without its own endpoint names its provider, e.g. `Anthropic`, as where the key is sent, instead of the provider's default endpoint, which the installation's LLM gateway sits in front of.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.36.0...v3.36.1
